test_title: PYST 86: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

Since you are so kind, / I would not run contrary to / your opinions.

options.text: I would not run contrary to

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is the incorrect use of the phrase "run contrary to."
 
• The standard expressions are "run counter to" or "go contrary to."
 
• Therefore, "run contrary to" is not grammatically correct.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Since you are so kind, I would not go contrary to your opinions."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "Since you are so kind,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "your opinions."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
